headline: The rupiah closes at a record low (JISDOR 18,250) two days before BI, so the 5–7Y cheapen ~1bp while the 1M–2Y rally 2–5bp; the 10Y holds at 7.70% (+0.5bp) against a 5bp Treasury rise and the daily flow signal deepens to −0.91
summary: PHEI's IGSYC steepened from the front: the 1M fell 5.1bp to 6.117% (the lowest of 13 stored days), the 1Y 3.2bp to 6.759% and the 2Y 1.8bp to 7.031%, while the 5Y rose 1.2bp to 7.481%, the 7Y 1.1bp to 7.624% and the 10Y 0.5bp to 7.697%. That lifted 2s5s 3.0bp to 45.1bp and 1s2s to 27.2bp, the steepest stored, and the 2s5s10s fly 3.7bp to 23.5bp; the 10Y is 6.9bp higher this month and in the 97th percentile of the past year. Benchmark FR0109 slipped 0.8bp to 7.459% (5.4bp cheap to the curve) and FR0108 rose 0.6bp to 7.604% (8.6bp rich). The fitted PBS curve is 0.5bp over IGSYC at 2Y and 0.8bp through at 5Y, PBS034 cheapened 2.5bp to 7.644% before Tuesday's reopening, the retail fit is 11.2bp rich at 5Y, and AAA 3Y eased 0.4bp to 7.699%, 48.7bp over, the narrowest of 12 stored days.
drivers: Rupiah at a record close before BI

JISDOR rose 0.18% to 18,250, its weakest fix on record, and spot closed 0.34% weaker at 18,268, also a record, as the dollar index held near 103.4 and Indonesia's risk premium stayed high. With BI deciding on Wednesday (a WSJ poll has 4 of 6 for a hold at 5.75%; RHB puts a 25bp hike at about 40%), the belly took the hit: 4–7Y rose 0.8–1.2bp. Why the 1M–2Y rallied instead is not published; demand for short paper ahead of Tuesday's SPN-S and sukuk auction is my hypothesis, not buyer-level data.
Treasuries rose again; INDOGBs barely moved

The US 10Y closed Friday 5bp higher at 5.15% (2Y +2bp to 4.88%), capping its biggest weekly rise of 2026 (+29bp). At the 1-year daily beta of 0.28 that implies +1.4bp for the INDOGB 10Y; it moved +0.5bp, so Treasuries account for more than the whole move. The INDOGB − UST spread narrowed to 254.7bp from 259.2bp (71st percentile of 52 weeks), a nominal pick-up before currency risk.
Stocks slipped on mining policy; foreigners sold

The JCI fell 0.44% to 5,320.98 and foreigners net sold about Rp303bn (Kontan); basic materials lost 4.3% and energy 2.9% on reports of a plan to make miners remit at least 70% of profits to the state and route exports through one channel. FTSE kept Indonesia's emerging-market status but will delete 14 stocks on Dec 21. Weak equities keep the JCI part of the flow signal bearish (20-session change −13.4%).

Tuesday's sukuk auction targets Rp10tn (up to Rp20tn) with reopenings of PBS040 and PBS034 and new PBS041 (2029) and PBS042 (2052); five SBN auctions remain this year and the budget deficit reached 1.47% of GDP by October. PBS034's 2.5bp cheapening looks like a pre-auction concession; long-end FR moved under 2bp either way.
data: Q3 external debt (Nov 16)
Small rise; no direct read for INDOGBs, but adds to the rupiah's funding story before Friday's Q3 balance of payments.
US October PPI (Nov 13)
Slight miss, yet the US 10Y still rose 5bp to 5.15% on Friday; December Fed-hike pricing intact.
FTSE December review (Nov 13)
Status unchanged, 14 deletions (f status unchanged, p freeze on additions)
Removes the FTSE downgrade risk for now; positive changes stay frozen until at least March 2027.
Budget through October (Nov 13)
Deficit 1.47% of GDP (f n/a, p 1.24% through Sep)
On track; financing outlook Rp734.3tn with five auctions left keeps supply steady, not heavy.
MSCI November review (Nov 12)
BRPT, BRMS out of Standard; 7 out of Small Cap (f BRPT, BRMS deletions expected; p index freeze)
In line; est. Rp1–1.2tn passive outflow on Nov 30. Standalone risk unchanged.
US October CPI (Nov 10)
Started the US sell-off; the dollar is the rupiah's main headwind.
SUN auction (Nov 10)
Bids Rp79.71tn (p Rp31.09tn); awarded Rp35tn vs Rp30tn target; FR0110 7.44%, FR0111 7.68%
Strong demand at higher yields; foreign bids 22.6% of the book.
view: The rupiah, not Treasuries, is still the binding input: a 5bp US rise left the 10Y up 0.5bp, while a record-weak currency two days before BI cheapened the 4–7Y and steepened 2s5s by 3bp. The daily Bond Flow Signal is −0.91 (sell-off, from −0.81 on Friday): the 10Y trend (z +1.78, +51.7bp over 20 sessions) and the JCI (z −1.35, −13.4%) are the bearish parts, the rupiah (z +0.83, +2.08%) mildly bearish, and the spread, 8.3bp above its 130-day average (z +0.31), is now barely supportive; the sell-off episode on the rebuilt daily build runs from Sep 28 (26 sessions, +48.9bp). Since July 2022 the daily signal scores a Sharpe of 0.80 outright and 0.84 hedged against Treasuries, but sell-off calls were right only 51% of the time over the next 20 sessions (rally calls 58%; hedged 65%) and the 10Y fell 0.8bp on average after them; its outright Sharpe was 1.02 in Jul 2022–Aug 2024 and 0.63 since. The weekly build scores 0.45 and 0.62, and a US-trend variant reaches 0.80 and 0.81 on the weekly build but was chosen after the fact and is not live; all are in-sample back-tests. Over four weeks the INDOGB 10Y is up 23.9bp while the US 10Y rose 19bp, yet at the weekly beta of −0.13 the Treasury-linked part is −2.4bp and +26.4bp is residual, the part Treasuries do not explain. I stay neutral on the 10Y in a 7.55–7.80% range into BI, keep the 5Y as the curve trade (buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70%), and see the 1–2Y as the most exposed if BI hikes.

buckets.name: Front end 1–2Y vs BI-Rate
buckets.why: The IGSYC 1Y fell 3.2bp to 6.759%, 100.9bp over the 5.75% BI-Rate (15th percentile of 13 stored days, average 108.4bp), still above my 6.75% no-chase line; the 2Y fell 1.8bp to 7.031% and 1s2s widened to 27.2bp, the steepest stored. The 3M (0.25Y) is 6.23% and the 1M 6.12%, the lowest stored. The 7.10% add level was not reached (34bp away); no position.
buckets.call: Neutral. Add 1–2Y only at 1Y 7.10% or after a BI hike that steadies JISDOR; a 25bp hike on Nov 18 would leave the 1Y only ~76bp over the new rate and hit this bucket first.

buckets.name: Belly 5Y (FR0109 / PBS040)
buckets.why: The IGSYC 5Y rose 1.2bp to 7.481% (62nd percentile of 13 stored days, average 7.491%), 4.1bp lower this month; the 2s5s10s fly rose 3.7bp to 23.5bp (62nd percentile, average 25.3bp). FR0109 eased 0.8bp to 7.459% and is 5.4bp cheap to the curve; PBS040 at 7.471% is 11.3bp cheap and is reopened on Tuesday. The entry (FR0109 7.60–7.70%) is 14bp away and not filled.
buckets.call: Buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70% after a BI hike or with JISDOR back below 18,000; target 7.35%, stop 7.95%.

buckets.name: 10Y outright
buckets.why: The IGSYC 10Y rose 0.5bp to 7.697%, 97th percentile of the past year (177 days, average 6.86%) and 2.8bp under the 7.724% high of Nov 4, against a 5bp US rise. The signal is −0.91, but the underweight rule also needs a 10Y close above 7.75%, so it is not triggered and the 7.55–7.80% range held. FR0108 rose 0.6bp to 7.604% and is 8.6bp rich.
buckets.call: Neutral, range 7.55–7.80%. Underweight if the signal stays below −0.5 and the 10Y closes above 7.75%; tactical long only above 7.85% (stop 8.05%) or once the signal is above 0 with JISDOR below 18,000.

buckets.name: 10s20s curve (FR0108 vs FR0107)
buckets.why: IGSYC 10s20s is 1.7bp (62nd percentile of 13 stored days, average 1.4bp, range 0.1–2.9bp); the range is tiny. The benchmark spread FR0107 − FR0108 narrowed to 11.0bp from 13.2bp as FR0107 gained 1.6bp and FR0108 lost 0.6bp, still 16bp from the −5bp re-entry.
buckets.call: Wait. Re-enter the FR0108/FR0107 steepener duration-weighted at −5bp or lower, target +5bp, stop −12bp.

buckets.name: PBS sukuk vs FR
buckets.stance: FR over PBS034; bid PBS040 at auction
buckets.why: The fitted PBS 5Y is 0.8bp through IGSYC (50th percentile of 12 stored days, average −1.7bp), the 2Y 0.5bp over and the 10Y 1.6bp through; the fit rests on four series (level −2.5bp, slope 4.7bp), so confidence is limited. PBS034 rose 2.5bp to 7.644% and is now 4.8bp rich (from 6.3bp), so the FR-over-PBS034 switch gained about 1.5bp; it stays open, with the switch-back (PBS034 5bp cheap) 10bp away. PBS040 is 11.3bp cheap.
buckets.call: Hold FR over PBS034; switch back once PBS034 is 5bp cheap to IGSYC. Buy-and-hold accounts can bid PBS040 at Tuesday's auction near 7.45–7.50%.

buckets.name: Corporate credit (AAA 3Y)
buckets.why: PHEI's AAA 3Y eased 0.4bp to 7.699%, 48.7bp over IGSYC, the narrowest of 12 stored days (8th percentile, average 50.3bp). AA widened to 90.2bp (the widest of 12 days, average 86.0bp), A is 151.6bp over, and BBB 223.1bp over AA (the narrowest, average 239.9bp). Twelve days is a thin base; the add level (AAA 3Y past 70bp) was not reached.
buckets.call: Hold AAA/AA; add only if AAA 3Y widens past 70bp. Avoid BBB until the rupiah and politics settle.

buckets.name: Retail SBN 5Y (ORI/SR)
buckets.why: The fitted retail curve is 11.2bp through IGSYC at 5Y (67th percentile of 12 stored days, average −13.4bp) and 10.0bp over at 2Y; the 21-series fit has an 80bp slope, so part of this is fit artefact. Secondary spreads run from 57bp rich (SR024T3) to 42bp cheap (ORI027T3); ORI026T6 is 7.596%, 30bp over. ST017 (open to Dec 2) floors at 6.95% (2Y) and 7.05% (4Y), below the IGSYC 2Y (7.03%).
buckets.call: For new money, FR0109 or PBS040 give daily liquidity; ST017 suits hold-to-maturity buyers who want BI-hike upside. Buy secondary retail only at the cheap end (ORI026T6, ~30bp over).

watch: Next: the sukuk auction with new PBS041/PBS042 (Tue Nov 17), BI's decision and September loan growth (Wed Nov 18), FOMC minutes and US data in the week of Nov 16, Indonesia's Q3 balance of payments (Fri Nov 20), MSCI changes after the Nov 30 close, the ST017 book closing Dec 2 and FTSE deletions on Dec 21; a 10Y close above 7.75% would trigger the underweight, while JISDOR back below 18,000 would push a BI hike out.
